common: add small persisted-row validators called on every existing-row/replay path before any provider/notifier call or result projection
parse stored JSON with exact canonical round-trip; malformed, missing, extra, type, binding or hash mismatch raises PublicControlError(PUBLIC_LEDGER_CORRUPT)
do not rewrite, repair or normalize a corrupted row; fail closed with zero mutation
preserve fresh-write validators and all existing typed inventory/lineage source-conflict classifications
lineage: first validate existing row internally from its stored state_json: JSON object, canonical bytes, non-empty state, terminalHash semantics, state column exact, terminal_hash exact and lineage_hash equals canonical state_json hash
an internally inconsistent stored row is PUBLIC_LEDGER_CORRUPT
only after internal validity compare the current caller source state_json/terminal hash; a different but internally valid caller lineage remains PUBLIC_LINEAGE_CONFLICT
the returned/result projection may use a persisted lineage row only after this validator
surface: validate issue/surface/artifact/idempotency binding and exact state-specific disposition, terminal hash, receipt and attempt count before returning an existing row
NOT_REQUIRED requires input eligibility already validated, state NOT_REQUIRED, disposition TERMINAL, attempt_count 0, receipt_json null and the deterministic NOT_REQUIRED terminal hash
inventory CONFIRMED requires state CONFIRMED, disposition TERMINAL, attempt_count 0, receipt_json null and deterministic inventory CONFIRMED terminal hash

published CONFIRMED from PENDING requires state CONFIRMED, disposition TERMINAL, attempt_count 1, canonical exact PUBLIC_SURFACE_RECEIPT_V1, receipt binding to surface/idempotency, terminal_hash equal receipt terminalHash; artifact is bound through the deterministic idempotency key
PENDING requires terminal_hash and receipt_json null plus either INTENT_DURABLE/attempt_count 0 or QUERY_REQUIRED/attempt_count 1
all other state/disposition/count/receipt combinations are PUBLIC_LEDGER_CORRUPT; do not dispatch/query after corruption
notification: validate existing idempotency key against issueDate+publicTerminalHash before state branching
CONFIRMED requires disposition TERMINAL, attempt_count 1 and canonical exact PUBLIC_NOTIFICATION_RECEIPT_V1 bound to the idempotency key with 64-hex terminalHash
PENDING requires receipt_json null and either INTENT_DURABLE or QUERY_REQUIRED with attempt_count 1
any syntax/schema/status/idempotency/terminalHash/state/disposition/count mismatch is PUBLIC_LEDGER_CORRUPT before notify/query
noRegression: publisher and notifier response-loss still resume query-first with blind retry zero
opaque non-empty mapping terminalHash remains preserved while full mapping hash protects immutability
Scheduled/Recovery/Public/Readiness order and scheduled-first overall-state behavior remain unchanged
caller-owned Scheduled source bytes remain unchanged
